name: clips/t2_soaked
prompt: First-person POV at night in the rain, looking down at your own white sneakers standing ankle-deep in dark rippling floodwater on stone paving. The feet shift slightly, water sloshing over the toes, raindrops hitting the surface and ripples spreading. After a moment the camera tilts slowly up from the feet to the flooded riverside path and the black river ahead in the rain, then starts walking forward again. Handheld, realistic, cinematic 35mm film look, no face visible, no text.
